The zip holds a .dxf (open in AutoCAD and Save As .dwg), an .svg for Illustrator or CorelDRAW, and a setup sheet. Red = cut, blue = score, black = engrave. DXF text comes in as outlines; fill the ENGRAVE layer before printing.
